title: Remote Control Design and Feature Planning Meeting
summary: The team met to discuss market survey findings and design concepts for a new remote control. Raj presented market trends highlighting a consumer preference for aesthetically pleasing, technologically innovative, and easy-to-use remote controls incorporating organic, fruit-inspired themes. Helen shared interface research, emphasizing simple layouts, speech recognition, and colorful button designs over complicated LCD screens. The group agreed on key features including voice recognition, rechargeable batteries with a dock, and an ergonomic double-curved shape using company colors. Finally, Raj and Helen were assigned to create a clay prototype before the next meeting.
topics: Market survey findings and trend analysis
Remote control physical and interface design
Power supply options and charging dock
decisions: Incorporate speech recognition into the remote control design
Exclude LCD screens to keep the product user-friendly and within budget
Use rechargeable batteries with a charging dock/stand
Adopt an ergonomic, double-curved shape inspired by organic fruit forms
Use company yellow and blue as the primary color scheme with multi-colored buttons

actions.task: Conduct a public survey testing two to three proposed remote control shape designs
Create a clay model of the remote control design
Re-upload the project documents to the shared folder
